description: Upload images (JPEG, PNG, WebP), caption sidecars (.txt/.json named like their image) and .zip archives into a dataset — an existing one by dataset_id, or a new one created from name — from local paths or public https URLs. Answers what was accepted and what failed and why.

dataset_id.description: The dataset to upload into; or give name to create one first

files.description: Images (JPEG, PNG, WebP), caption sidecars (.txt or .json, named like their image) and/or .zip archives of both: local paths or public https URLs; the file's NAME is sent (the API pairs a caption by it); a dataset holds up to 100 images

name.description: Create a new dataset with this name, then upload into it
